pass: Speaks to the small spider this turn to make it stop (an order or a warning), treating it as one of her own kin; attacking it in the same turn is also fine. Does not ignore it, flee, or try to bargain at length. No friendliness.

earlier: Vesh came to the labyrinth because she felt one of her children, the great spider Queen, being devoured from within.
The Queen is Vesh's own kin, as all spiders are. The small white spider eating her is one of Vesh's kin too, but a strange one: it does not answer her call.
